narrative.weekly_mirror: Your week held two different kinds of connection. After your water pollution lesson, Ravi told you that his mother had asked him to explain it, while your call with Didi ended with the realisation that “we didn't talk about...” much beyond the furniture.
narrative.tension_explanation: There is no clear sign this week of movement away from making the world a fairer, better place. At the same time, the two entries leave different parts of your experience visible: one shows an idea travelling from your classroom into a family conversation, and the other leaves an unfinished feeling around contact with someone close.
narrative.reflective_question: What feels most important to notice between the impact your teaching had on Ravi’s family and what was left unsaid with Didi?
